title: DNS Record IBB - agnostic input contract

requesterIdentity.description: Authenticated caller identity (a non-human identity for automation) (CON-009).

correlationId.description: End-to-end traceability across portal, orchestrator, pipeline, IaC, resource (CON-009, EVD-003).

changeReference.description: Approved change record reference. Required by policy for prd (SBP AWS-005); enforced conditionally in the pipeline, not the schema.

requirements.description: Agnostic, capability-specific knobs, nested by the fixed high-level categories (sizing/access/resilience/security/operations) from requirement-dictionary/requirement-properties.yaml, per scaffold-ibb SKILL.md §1b. Do NOT put dataClassification here — it is a mandatory context field, already required above.

dnsZone.description: The DNS zone the record belongs to, identified by its domain name (e.g. example.com.). Maps to the provider's hosted-zone/DNS-zone resource.

recordName.description: The record's name, relative to dnsZone (e.g. "www" for www.example.com.).

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live, in seconds, for the record's cache lifetime.

recordValues.description: The record's target value(s) — IP address(es) for A, a hostname for CNAME, or string content for TXT.
